verses.en: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
verses.pt: Por isso eu te exorto, antes de tudo, que se façam pedidos, orações, intercessões e atos de gratidão por todas as pessoas;
verses.en_web: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks, be made for all men:
verses.en_bbe: My desire is, first of all, that you will make requests and prayers and give praise for all men;

verses.en: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.
verses.pt: pelos reis, e por todos os que estão em posição superior, para que tenhamos uma vida quieta e sossegada, em toda devoção divina e honestidade.
verses.en_web: for kings and all who are in high places; that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.
verses.en_bbe: For kings and all those in authority; so that we may have a calm and quiet life in all fear of God and serious behaviour.

verses.en: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;
verses.pt: Pois isso é bom e agradável diante de Deus nosso Salvador;
verses.en_web: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior;
verses.en_bbe: This is good and pleasing in the eyes of God our Saviour;

verses.en: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.
verses.pt: que quer que todas as pessoas se salvem e venham ao conhecimento da verdade.
verses.en_web: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.
verses.en_bbe: Whose desire is that all men may have salvation and come to the knowledge of what is true.

verses.en: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
verses.pt: Pois há um só Deus, e um só Mediador entre Deus e os seres humanos: o humano Cristo Jesus.
verses.en_web: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
verses.en_bbe: For there is one God and one peacemaker between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

verses.en: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.
verses.pt: Ele mesmo se deu como resgate por todos, como testemunho ao seu tempo.
verses.en_web: who gave himself as a ransom for all; the testimony in its own times;
verses.en_bbe: Who gave himself as an offering for all; witness of which was to be given at the right time;

verses.en: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.
verses.pt: Para isso fui constituído pregador e apóstolo, instrutor dos gentios na fé e na verdade (estou dizendo a verdade em Cristo, não mentindo).
verses.en_web: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle (I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying), a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.
verses.en_bbe: And of this I became a preacher and an Apostle (what I say is true, not false,) and a teacher of the Gentiles in the true faith.

verses.en: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
verses.pt: Portanto, quero que os homens orem em todo lugar, levantando mãos santas, sem ira nem briga.
verses.en_web: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.
verses.en_bbe: It is my desire, then, that in every place men may give themselves to prayer, lifting up holy hands, without wrath or argument.

verses.en: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;
verses.pt: De semelhante maneira, as mulheres se adornem com roupa respeitosa, com pudor e sobriedade, não com tranças, ouro, pérolas, ou roupas caras;
verses.en_web: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety; not just with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing;
verses.en_bbe: And that women may be dressed in simple clothing, with a quiet and serious air; not with twisted hair and gold or jewels or robes of great price;

verses.en: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.
verses.pt: mas sim, com boas obras, como é adequado às mulheres que declaram reverência a Deus.
verses.en_web: but (which becomes women professing godliness) with good works.
verses.en_bbe: But clothed with good works, as is right for women who are living in the fear of God.

verses.en: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.
verses.pt: A mulher aprenda quietamente, com toda submissão.
verses.en_web: Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission.
verses.en_bbe: Let a woman quietly take the place of a learner and be under authority.

verses.en: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.
verses.pt: Porém não permito que a mulher ensine, nem use de autoridade sobre o marido, mas sim, que esteja em silêncio.
verses.en_web: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.
verses.en_bbe: In my opinion it is right for a woman not to be a teacher, or to have rule over a man, but to be quiet.

verses.en: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
verses.pt: Pois primeiro foi formado Adão, depois Eva.
verses.en_web: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
verses.en_bbe: For Adam was first formed, then Eve;

verses.en: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.
verses.pt: E Adão não foi enganado; mas a mulher foi enganada, e caiu em transgressão.
verses.en_web: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;
verses.en_bbe: And Adam was not taken by deceit, but the woman, being tricked, became a wrongdoer.

verses.en: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.
verses.pt: Porém ela se salvará tendo parto, se permanecerem na fé, amor, e santificação com sobriedade.
verses.en_web: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and sanctification with sobriety.
verses.en_bbe: But if they go on in faith and love and holy self-control, she will be kept safe at the time of childbirth.
